<script>
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
GOOGLE SHEETS ONLY - NO FAKE STOCK
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
// ⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡
// REPLACE WITH YOUR PUBLISHED GOOGLE SHEET URL
// ⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡⚡
const https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vRoXD8Y7xTji3S1bA7HUxC5BE_u9WTQz90mOlMLzy5rmhHRCfhwjisC4A3hJ2rl77OyaQmuokUkxY8Z/pub?output=csv
// Global variables
let PRODUCTS = [];
let SETTINGS = {};
let currentCat = 'all';
let activeFilters = { category: [], fabric: [], gsm: [], status: [], format: [] };
let currentSort = 'featured';
let searchQuery = '';
let visibleCount = 20;
let cart = [];
let wishlist = [];
let orderCounter = 1000;
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
INITIALIZATION - LOADS ONLY FROM GOOGLE SHEETS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
async function initApp() {
console.log('🚀 Initializing app from Google Sheets...');
// Show loading overlay
document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', `
<div id="loadingOverlay" style="
position: fixed;
inset: 0;
background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
z-index: 9999;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
flex-direction: column;">
<div style="font-size: 3rem; margin-bottom: 20px;">📥</div>
<h2 style="font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 10px;">Loading Inventory</h2>
<p style="color: #666;">Fetching product data from Google Sheets...</p>
<p style="color: #999; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 0.8rem;">No fake stock - only real products from your sheet</p>
</div>
`);
try {
// Fetch all data from Google Sheets
const response = await fetch(GOOGLE_SHEET_CSV_URL + '?t=' + Date.now());
if (!response.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status);
const csvText = await response.text();
const products = parseCSV(csvText);
if (products.length === 0) {
throw new Error('No products found in Google Sheet');
}
// Successfully loaded products
PRODUCTS = products;
console.log(`✅ Loaded ${PRODUCTS.length} real products from Google Sheet`);
// Extract unique categories and fabrics
window.CATEGORIES = [...new Set(PRODUCTS.map(p => p.category))];
window.FABRICS = [...new Set(PRODUCTS.map(p => p.fabric))];
window.GSM_OPTIONS = [...new Set(PRODUCTS.map(p => p.gsm))];
window.FORMATS = [...new Set(PRODUCTS.map(p => p.format))];
// Update total products stat
const statEl = document.getElementById('totalProducts');
if (statEl) statEl.textContent = PRODUCTS.length;
} catch (error) {
console.error('❌ Failed to load from Google Sheet:', error);
// CRITICAL: No fallback products - show empty state
PRODUCTS = [];
window.CATEGORIES = [];
window.FABRICS = [];
window.GSM_OPTIONS = [];
window.FORMATS = [];
// Update stats
const statEl = document.getElementById('totalProducts');
if (statEl) statEl.textContent = '0';
}
// Render UI
renderCategoryPills();
renderFilters();
renderProducts();
// Remove loading overlay
const overlay = document.getElementById('loadingOverlay');
if (overlay) overlay.remove();
}
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
CSV PARSING (FROM GOOGLE SHEETS)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function parseCSV(csvText) {
const lines = csvText.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
if (lines.length < 2) return [];
const headers = parseCSVLine(lines[0]);
const products = [];
for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
const values = parseCSVLine(lines[i]);
if (values.length <= 1 && !values[0]?.trim()) continue;
const product = {};
headers.forEach((header, idx) => {
product[header.trim()] = values[idx] ? values[idx].trim() : '';
});
// Type conversion
product.id = parseInt(product.id) || (i + 1);
product.price = parseFloat(product.price) || 0;
product.stock = parseInt(product.stock) || 0;
product.moq = parseInt(product.moq) || 10;
product.featured = product.featured || 'no';
// Auto-calculate status if not specified
if (!product.status || product.status.trim() === '') {
if (product.stock > 500) product.status = 'in-stock';
else if (product.stock > 150) product.status = 'low-stock';
else if (product.stock === 0) product.status = 'out-of-stock';
else product.status = 'made-to-order';
}
// Handle images
if (product.images && product.images.includes(',')) {
product.imageList = product.images.split(',').map(img => img.trim());
} else {
product.imageList = [product.images || ''];
}
product.mockup = product.imageList[0] || generateSVGMockup(product.category, product.color || '#1e3a8a');
// Defaults
product.category = product.category || 'Uncategorized';
product.format = product.format || 'Standard';
product.fabric = product.fabric || 'Cotton';
product.gsm = product.gsm || '160 GSM';
product.gender = product.gender || 'Unisex';
product.description = product.description || 'Premium quality custom sublimation product.';
product.name = product.name || 'Product ' + product.id;
product.sku = product.sku || 'AZ-' + product.id;
product.color = product.color || '#888888';
products.push(product);
}
return products;
}
function parseCSVLine(line) {
const result = [];
let current = '';
let inQuotes = false;
for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
const char = line[i];
if (char === '"' && line[i + 1] === '"') {
current += '"';
i++;
} else if (char === '"') {
inQuotes = !inQuotes;
} else if (char === ',' && !inQuotes) {
result.push(current);
current = '';
} else {
current += char;
}
}
result.push(current);
return result;
}
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
SVG MOCKUP GENERATOR (BACKUP ONLY FOR MISSING IMAGES)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function generateSVGMockup(type, color) {
const base = {
'T-Shirt': `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 250"><path d="M100 45 L75 35 L45 50 L15 90 L35 105 L50 95 L50 200 L150 200 L150 95 L165 105 L185 90 L155 50 L125 35 Z" fill="${color}" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/><path d="M75 35 L100 45 L85 60" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.4"/><path d="M125 35 L100 45 L115 60" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.4"/></svg>`,
'Hoodie': `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 250"><path d="M100 40 L70 30 L40 50 L20 85 L40 100 L50 95 L55 200 L145 200 L150 95 L160 100 L180 85 L160 50 L130 30 Z" fill="${color}" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/><path d="M100 40 L80 60 L120 60 Z" fill="#111" opacity="0.5"/></svg>`,
'Polo': `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 250"><path d="M100 40 L80 25 L50 40 L20 70 L40 85 L55 180 L100 200 L145 180 L160 85 L180 70 L150 40 L120 25 Z" fill="${color}" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/><path d="M80 25 L100 45 L120 25 L100 10 Z" fill="#fff" opacity="0.4"/></svg>`,
'Jersey': `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 250"><path d="M100 30 L75 20 L45 35 L15 70 L35 85 L50 75 L50 200 L150 200 L150 75 L165 85 L185 70 L155 35 L125 20 Z" fill="${color}" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/><path d="M50 75 L100 90 L150 75" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.4"/></svg>`,
'Sweatshirt': `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 250"><path d="M100 30 L70 40 L40 60 L20 90 L40 100 L50 95 L50 200 L150 200 L150 95 L160 100 L180 90 L160 60 L130 40 Z" fill="${color}" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/></svg>`,
'Jogger': `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 250"><path d="M80 40 L120 40 L135 120 L125 220 L100 230 L75 220 L65 120 Z" fill="${color}" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/></svg>`,
'Short': `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 250"><path d="M80 50 L120 50 L140 120 L130 180 L100 190 L70 180 L60 120 Z" fill="${color}" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/></svg>`,
'Tracksuit': `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 250"><path d="M100 30 L70 40 L40 60 L20 90 L40 100 L50 95 L50 200 L150 200 L150 95 L160 100 L180 90 L160 60 L130 40 Z" fill="${color}" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/></svg>`
};
return base[type] || base['T-Shirt'];
}
function dataURLFromSVG(svg) {
try {
return 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(svg)));
} catch(e) {
return 'data:image/svg+xml,' + encodeURIComponent(svg);
}
}
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
RENDERING FUNCTIONS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderCategoryPills() {
const pillArea = document.getElementById('categoryPills');
if (!pillArea) return;
const cats = ['all', ...CATEGORIES];
pillArea.innerHTML = cats.map(c =>
`<button class="cat-pill" data-cat="${c}" onclick="selectCategory('${c}')">${c === 'all' ? 'ALL' : c.toUpperCase()}</button>`
).join('');
}
function renderFilters() {
document.getElementById('filterCategory').innerHTML = CATEGORIES.map(c =>
`<label class="filter-option"><input type="checkbox" value="${c}" onchange="onFilterChange('category')"> ${c}</label>`
).join('');
document.getElementById('filterFabric').innerHTML = FABRICS.map(f =>
`<label class="filter-option"><input type="checkbox" value="${f}" onchange="onFilterChange('fabric')"> ${f}</label>`
).join('');
document.getElementById('filterGsm').innerHTML = GSM_OPTIONS.map(g =>
`<label class="filter-option"><input type="checkbox" value="${g}" onchange="onFilterChange('gsm')"> ${g}</label>`
).join('');
document.getElementById('filterAvailability').innerHTML = `
<label class="filter-option"><input type="checkbox" value="in-stock" onchange="onFilterChange('status')"> In Stock</label>
<label class="filter-option"><input type="checkbox" value="low-stock" onchange="onFilterChange('status')"> Low Stock</label>
<label class="filter-option"><input type="checkbox" value="made-to-order" onchange="onFilterChange('status')"> Made to Order</label>
`;
document.getElementById('filterFormat').innerHTML = FORMATS.map(f =>
`<label class="filter-option"><input type="checkbox" value="${f}" onchange="onFilterChange('format')"> ${f}</label>`
).join('');
}
function getFilteredProducts(sortOverride) {
let products = [...PRODUCTS];
if (currentCat !== 'all') products = products.filter(p => p.category === currentCat);
if (searchQuery) {
const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
products = products.filter(p =>
p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
p.sku.toLowerCase().includes(q)
);
}
if (activeFilters.category.length) products = products.filter(p => activeFilters.category.includes(p.category));
if (activeFilters.fabric.length) products = products.filter(p => activeFilters.fabric.includes(p.fabric));
if (activeFilters.gsm.length) products = products.filter(p => activeFilters.gsm.includes(p.gsm));
if (activeFilters.status.length) products = products.filter(p => activeFilters.status.includes(p.status));
if (activeFilters.format.length) products = products.filter(p => activeFilters.format.includes(p.format));
const sort = sortOverride || currentSort;
switch (sort) {
case 'featured':
products.sort((a, b) => {
if (a.featured === 'yes' && b.featured !== 'yes') return -1;
if (a.featured !== 'yes' && b.featured === 'yes') return 1;
return b.id - a.id;
});
break;
case 'newest': products.sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id); break;
case 'price-asc': products.sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price); break;
case 'price-desc': products.sort((a, b) => b.price - a.price); break;
case 'name': products.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)); break;
case 'stock': products.sort((a, b) => b.stock - a.stock); break;
}
return products;
}
function renderProducts() {
const products = getFilteredProducts();
const grid = document.getElementById('productsGrid');
const visible = products.slice(0, visibleCount);
const resultCount = document.getElementById('resultCount');
if (resultCount) resultCount.textContent = products.length + ' products';
if (!visible.length) {
if (grid) grid.innerHTML = `
<div class="text-center" style="padding:40px; grid-column:1/-1;">
<div style="font-size:3rem; margin-bottom:20px;">📦</div>
<h3>No products found</h3>
<p style="margin:20px 0; color:#666;">
Add products to your Google Sheet to display them here.<br>
Sheet URL: ${GOOGLE_SHEET_CSV_URL ? 'Connected ✓' : 'Not set ✗'}
</p>
<p style="color:#999; font-size:0.85rem;">
Current stock count: 0 products
</p>
</div>
`;
document.getElementById('loadMoreWrap').style.display = 'none';
return;
}
grid.innerHTML = visible.map(p => {
const statusClass = {
'in-stock': 'stock-in',
'low-stock': 'stock-low',
'out-of-stock': 'stock-out',
'made-to-order': 'stock-made'
}[p.status] || 'stock-in';
const statusText = {
'in-stock': 'IN STOCK (' + p.stock + ')',
'low-stock': 'LOW STOCK (' + p.stock + ')',
'out-of-stock': 'OUT OF STOCK',
'made-to-order': 'MADE TO ORDER'
}[p.status] || 'IN STOCK';
return `
<div class="product-card">
<span class="stock-badge ${statusClass}" style="position:absolute; top:10px; left:10px; z-index:2;">${statusText}</span>
<button class="quick-view" onclick="openPDP(${p.id})">👁️</button>
<div class="product-img-wrap" onclick="openPDP(${p.id})">
<img src="${p.mockup}" alt="${p.name}" class="product-img" loading="lazy">
</div>
<div class="product-info">
<div class="product-category">${p.category} • ${p.format}</div>
<div class="product-title">${p.name}</div>
<div class="product-meta" style="display:flex; gap:10px; font-size:0.7rem; color:#999; margin-bottom:8px;">
<span>${p.fabric}</span><span>•</span><span>${p.gsm}</span>
</div>
<div class="product-price-row">
<div class="product-price">$${p.price.toFixed(2)} <small>/ pc</small></div>
<span class="small">MOQ: ${p.moq}</span>
</div>
</div>
<button class="quick-add" onclick="addToCart(${p.id})" ${p.status === 'out-of-stock' ? 'disabled style="background:#999;"' : ''}>
${p.status === 'out-of-stock' ? 'OUT OF STOCK' : 'ADD TO CART'}
</button>
</div>
`;
}).join('');
document.getElementById('loadMoreWrap').style.display = products.length > visibleCount ? 'block' : 'none';
}
function loadMore() {
visibleCount += 20;
renderProducts();
}
function reloadProducts() {
currentSort = document.getElementById('sortSelect').value;
visibleCount = 20;
renderProducts();
}
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
FILTER FUNCTIONS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function onFilterChange(group) {
activeFilters[group] = [...document.querySelectorAll('#filter' + group.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + group.slice(1) + ' input:checked')].map(el => el.value);
visibleCount = 20;
renderProducts();
}
function clearFilters() {
activeFilters = { category: [], fabric: [], gsm: [], status: [], format: [] };
document.querySelectorAll('.filter-group input').forEach(el => el.checked = false);
visibleCount = 20;
renderProducts();
}
function selectCategory(cat) {
currentCat = cat;
visibleCount = 20;
renderProducts();
}
function globalSearchFilter(e) {
searchQuery = e.target.value;
visibleCount = 20;
renderProducts();
}
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
CART SYSTEM
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function addToCart(id, qty = 10) {
const p = PRODUCTS.find(x => x.id === id);
if (!p || p.status === 'out-of-stock') return;
const item = cart.find(c => c.id === id);
if (item) {
item.qty += qty;
} else {
cart.push({
id: p.id,
name: p.name,
sku: p.sku,
price: parseFloat(p.price),
qty: qty,
mockup: p.mockup,
category: p.category
});
}
updateCart();
toggleCart(true);
}
function updateCart() {
const countEl = document.getElementById('cartCount');
if (countEl) countEl.textContent = cart.reduce((s, i) => s + i.qty, 0);
const itemContainer = document.getElementById('cartItems');
if (!itemContainer) return;
if (!cart.length) {
itemContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center" style="padding:40px 0;"><div style="font-size:3rem;">🛒</div><p style="margin:15px 0;">Cart is empty</p></div>';
const subtotalEl = document.getElementById('cartSubtotal');
if (subtotalEl) subtotalEl.textContent = '$0';
return;
}
itemContainer.innerHTML = cart.map((item, i) => `
<div class="cart-item">
<div class="cart-item-img"><img src="${item.mockup}" alt="${item.name}" style="width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover;"></div>
<div class="cart-item-info">
<div class="cart-item-title">${item.name}</div>
<div class="cart-item-sku">SKU: ${item.sku}</div>
<div class="cart-item-variants">Qty: ${item.qty} pcs</div>
<div class="cart-item-quantity">
<button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i}, -10)">−</button>
<span class="qty-value">${item.qty}</span>
<button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i}, 10)">+</button>
<span style="margin-left:auto; font-weight:600;">$${(item.price * item.qty).toFixed(2)}</span>
</div>
<button class="cart-item-remove" onclick="removeFromCart(${i})">Remove</button>
</div>
</div>
`).join('');
const subtotalEl = document.getElementById('cartSubtotal');
if (subtotalEl) {
subtotalEl.textContent = '$' + cart.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0).toFixed(2);
}
}
function changeQty(idx, delta) {
cart[idx].qty = Math.max(10, cart[idx].qty + delta);
updateCart();
}
function removeFromCart(idx) {
cart.splice(idx, 1);
updateCart();
}
function toggleCart(forceOpen) {
const overlay = document.getElementById('cartOverlay');
const drawer = document.getElementById('cartDrawer');
if (!overlay || !drawer) return;
if (forceOpen) {
overlay.classList.add('active');
drawer.classList.add('active');
} else {
overlay.classList.toggle('active');
drawer.classList.toggle('active');
}
}
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
ORDER PROCESSING + NOTIFICATIONS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
async function requestQuoteFromCart() {
if (!cart.length) {
alert('Your cart is empty!');
return;
}
const orderNumber = 'ORD-' + Date.now().toString().slice(-6);
const orderDate = new Date().toLocaleString();
// Show confirmation with order details
let confirmMsg = 'Send quote request for Order #' + orderNumber + '?\n\n';
confirmMsg += 'Items:\n';
cart.forEach(i => {
confirmMsg += '- ' + i.qty + 'x ' + i.sku + ' @ $' + i.price.toFixed(2) + '\n';
});
confirmMsg += '\nTotal: $' + cart.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0).toFixed(2);
if (!confirm(confirmMsg)) return;
// Send WhatsApp notification
await sendCartWhatsApp(orderNumber, orderDate);
// Send Email notification (implement based on your email service)
await sendEmailNotification(orderNumber, orderDate);
// Clear cart
cart = [];
updateCart();
toggleCart(false);
alert('✅ Thank you!\n\nYour quote request (' + orderNumber + ') has been sent!\nWe will contact you shortly via WhatsApp.');
}
function sendCartWhatsApp(orderNum, date) {
let text = '*NEW QUOTE REQUEST - AZAN IMPEX*\n\n';
text += '*Order: ' + orderNum + '*\n';
text += '*Date: ' + date + '*\n\n';
text += '*ORDER ITEMS:*\n';
cart.forEach(i => {
text += '- ' + i.sku + ': ' + i.qty + ' pcs @ $' + i.price.toFixed(2) + '/pc = $' + (i.price * i.qty).toFixed(2) + '\n';
text += ' ' + i.name + '\n\n';
});
const total = cart.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
text += '*TOTAL: $' + total.toFixed(2) + '*\n\n';
text += 'Please prepare a quote for this order. Customer will be contacted shortly.';
const whatsappNumber = '923250043448';
const url = 'https://wa.me/' + whatsappNumber + '?text=' + encodeURIComponent(text);
window.open(url, '_blank');
}
function sendEmailNotification(orderNum, date) {
// Example using fetch to your backend or third-party service
console.log('📧 Email notification for order:', orderNum);
// You would integrate with services like:
// - SendGrid API
// - Mailgun
// - EmailJS
// - Your own backend
/* Example with fetch to custom endpoint:
fetch('https://your-backend.com/api/orders', {
method: 'POST',
headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
body: JSON.stringify({
orderNumber: orderNum,
date: date,
items: cart,
total: cart.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0)
})
});
*/
}
function sendCartWhatsApp() {
// Keep for direct "Send via WhatsApp" button
requestQuoteFromCart();
}
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
WISHLIST SYSTEM
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function toggleWishlist(forceOpen) {
const modal = document.getElementById('wishlistModal');
if (!modal) return;
if (forceOpen) modal.classList.add('active');
else modal.classList.toggle('active');
updateWishlist();
}
function closeWishlist() {
const modal = document.getElementById('wishlistModal');
if (modal) modal.classList.remove('active');
}
function updateWishlist() {
const countEl = document.getElementById('wishlistCount');
if (countEl) countEl.textContent = wishlist.length;
const content = document.getElementById('wishlistContent');
if (!content) return;
if (!wishlist.length) {
content.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center" style="padding:30px 0;"><p>Wishlist is empty</p></div>';
return;
}
content.innerHTML = wishlist.map(id => {
const p = PRODUCTS.find(x => x.id === id);
if (!p) return '';
return `
<div class="cart-item">
<div class="cart-item-img"><img src="${p.mockup}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;" onclick="openPDP(${p.id}); closeWishlist();"></div>
<div class="cart-item-info">
<div class="cart-item-title">${p.name}</div>
<div class="cart-item-sku">$${p.price} / pc</div>
<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:10px;">
<button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="addToCart(${p.id}); closeWishlist();">ADD TO CART</button>
<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onclick="wishlist = wishlist.filter(x => x !== ${p.id}); updateWishlist();">REMOVE</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
`;
}).join('');
}
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
PRODUCT DETAIL PAGE (PDP)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function openPDP(id) {
const p = PRODUCTS.find(x => x.id === id);
if (!p) return;
const sizes = ['XS', 'S', 'M', 'L', 'XL', '2XL', '3XL'];
const statusText = {
'in-stock': 'IN STOCK (' + p.stock + ' available)',
'low-stock': 'LOW STOCK (' + p.stock + ' available)',
'out-of-stock': 'OUT OF STOCK',
'made-to-order': 'MADE TO ORDER'
}[p.status] || 'IN STOCK';
document.getElementById('pdpContent').innerHTML = `
<div class="pdp-grid">
<div class="pdp-img">
<img src="${p.mockup}" alt="${p.name}" style="width:100%;">
</div>
<div>
<div class="product-category" style="margin-bottom:5px;">${p.category} • ${p.format} • ${p.gender}</div>
<h2 class="pdp-title">${p.name}</h2>
<div class="pdp-sku">SKU: ${p.sku}</div>
<div class="pdp-price">$${p.price.toFixed(2)} <span style="font-size:0.9rem; color:#888;">/ piece (wholesale)</span></div>
<div style="margin-bottom:15px;">
<span class="stock-badge ${p.status === 'in-stock' ? 'stock-in' : p.status === 'low-stock' ? 'stock-low' : p.status === 'out-of-stock' ? 'stock-out' : 'stock-made'}">${statusText}</span>
</div>
<p class="pdp-description">${p.description}</p>
<div class="pdp-specs">
<p><strong>Fabric:</strong> ${p.fabric}</p>
<p><strong>Weight:</strong> ${p.gsm}</p>
<p><strong>MOQ:</strong> ${p.moq} pcs</p>
<p><strong>Print Method:</strong> Full-Dye Sublimation</p>
<p><strong>Customization:</strong> Unlimited Colors, Logos, Names, Numbers</p>
</div>
<label style="font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:600; display:block; margin-bottom:8px;">SELECT SIZE</label>
<div class="size-row" id="pdpSizeRow">
${sizes.map(s => `<button class="size-btn" onclick="this.classList.toggle('selected');">${s}</button>`).join('')}
</div>
<label style="font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:600; display:block; margin-bottom:8px;">QUANTITY (PCS)</label>
<div class="qty-row">
<button class="qty-btn" onclick="qtyStepper(-10)">−</button>
<span class="qty-value" id="pdpQty">50</span>
<button class="qty-btn" onclick="qtyStepper(10)">+</button>
</div>
<div class="pdp-actions">
<button class="btn btn-yellow" onclick="addToCart(${p.id}, parseInt(document.getElementById('pdpQty').textContent)); closePDP();" ${p.status === 'out-of-stock' ? 'disabled style="background:#999;"' : ''}>ADD TO CART</button>
<div class="two-col">
<button class="btn btn-dark" onclick="closePDP(); document.getElementById('products-section').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});">CUSTOMIZE</button>
<a href="https://wa.me/923250043448?text=Hello%20Azan%20Impex,%20inquiry%20for%20SKU:%20${p.sku}" target="_blank" class="btn btn-outline">WHATSAPP</a>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
`;
const modal = document.getElementById('pdpModal');
if (modal) modal.classList.add('active');
}
function closePDP() {
const modal = document.getElementById('pdpModal');
if (modal) modal.classList.remove('active');
}
let pdpQtyVal = 50;
function qtyStepper(delta) {
pdpQtyVal = Math.max(10, pdpQtyVal + delta);
const qtyEl = document.getElementById('pdpQty');
if (qtyEl) qtyEl.textContent = pdpQtyVal;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
AUTO-REFRESH FROM GOOGLE SHEETS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
setInterval(async () => {
console.log('🔄 Checking for updates from Google Sheets...');
try {
const response = await fetch(GOOGLE_SHEET_CSV_URL + '?t=' + Date.now());
if (response.ok) {
const csvText = await response.text();
const newProducts = parseCSV(csvText);
if (newProducts.length > 0 && newProducts.length !== PRODUCTS.length) {
const oldCount = PRODUCTS.length;
PRODUCTS = newProducts;
CATEGORIES = [...new Set(PRODUCTS.map(p => p.category))];
FABRICS = [...new Set(PRODUCTS.map(p => p.fabric))];
GSM_OPTIONS = [...new Set(PRODUCTS.map(p => p.gsm))];
FORMATS = [...new Set(PRODUCTS.map(p => p.format))];
renderCategoryPills();
renderFilters();
renderProducts();
const statEl = document.getElementById('totalProducts');
if (statEl) statEl.textContent = PRODUCTS.length;
console.log('✅ Updated: ' + oldCount + ' → ' + PRODUCTS.length + ' products');
// Show notification (optional)
if (oldCount !== PRODUCTS.length) {
const notif = document.createElement('div');
notif.innerHTML = '📦 Inventory updated. Now showing ' + PRODUCTS.length + ' products.';
notif.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:20px;right:20px;background:#111;color:#fff;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:8px;z-index:9999;font-size:0.9rem;';
document.body.appendChild(notif);
setTimeout(() => notif.remove(), 5000);
}
}
}
} catch (error) {
console.warn('⚠️ Auto-refresh failed:', error);
}
}, 120000); // Check every 2 minutes
